Simon vs. the Homo Sapiens Agenda.synopsis: Closeted Simon is blackmailed over his secret emails with a classmate, and he has to decide how to come out.

Six of Crows.author: Leigh Bardugo
Six of Crows.synopsis: A brilliant criminal assembles a crew of outcasts for an impossible heist in a heavily guarded fortress.

Skyward.author: Brandon Sanderson
Skyward.synopsis: Spensa dreams of becoming a pilot to defend her planet and to clear her father’s disgraced name.

Spinning Silver.author: Naomi Novik
Spinning Silver.synopsis: A moneylender’s daughter who can turn silver into gold draws the attention of the icy king of the Staryk.

Stalking Jack the Ripper.author: Kerri Maniscalco
Stalking Jack the Ripper.synopsis: Audrey Rose, who secretly studies forensic medicine, investigates the Whitechapel murders in Victorian London.

Stardust.author: Neil Gaiman
Stardust.synopsis: A young man crosses into the faerie realm to bring back a fallen star for the girl he loves.

Station Eleven.author: Emily St. John Mandel
Station Eleven.synopsis: Years after a pandemic collapses civilization, a traveling troupe of actors performs Shakespeare for survivors.

Strange the Dreamer.author: Laini Taylor
Strange the Dreamer.synopsis: A dreamy young librarian joins an expedition to the mysterious lost city of Weep.

Temeraire.author: Naomi Novik
Temeraire.synopsis: During the Napoleonic Wars, a British naval captain bonds with a rare and extraordinary dragon.

The 5th Wave.author: Rick Yancey
The 5th Wave.synopsis: After four waves of alien attacks, Cassie fights to survive and to find her little brother.

The ABC Murders.author: Agatha Christie
The ABC Murders.synopsis: A killer sends Poirot taunting letters announcing crimes in alphabetical order.

The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.author: Mark Twain
The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.synopsis: A mischievous boy gets into trouble and adventure along the Mississippi River.

The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.author: Suzanne Collins
The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes.synopsis: Young Coriolanus Snow mentors a tribute in the tenth Hunger Games and begins to take shape as the future ruler.

The Bear and the Nightingale.author: Katherine Arden
The Bear and the Nightingale.synopsis: Vasya sees the household spirits of medieval Russia, and an old evil is waking in the forest.

The BFG.author: Roald Dahl
The BFG.synopsis: Sophie is snatched from her bed by a giant who collects dreams and blows them into children’s rooms.

The Call of the Wild.author: Jack London
The Call of the Wild.synopsis: Buck, a pampered dog, is stolen and forced to survive as a sled dog during the Klondike gold rush.

The Chronicles of Narnia.author: C. S. Lewis
The Chronicles of Narnia.synopsis: Four siblings step through a wardrobe into a magical land trapped in endless winter under a wicked witch.

The Coldest Girl in Coldtown.author: Holly Black
The Coldest Girl in Coldtown.synopsis: Tana wakes after a party to find a house full of dead teens and a vampire, and she enters Coldtown.

The Count of Monte Cristo.author: Alexandre Dumas
The Count of Monte Cristo.synopsis: Edmond Dantès is wrongly imprisoned, escapes and plans an elaborate revenge on those who betrayed him.

The Cruel Prince.author: Holly Black
The Cruel Prince.synopsis: Jude, a mortal girl raised in the faerie High Court, fights for a place among people who despise her.

The Da Vinci Code.author: Dan Brown
The Da Vinci Code.synopsis: A symbologist races across Paris and London to decode clues tied to a secret society after a murder at the Louvre.

The Darkest Part of the Forest.author: Holly Black
The Darkest Part of the Forest.synopsis: In a town on the edge of the faerie world, Hazel and her brother Ben must save everyone when a prince wakes.

The Exorcist.author: William Peter Blatty
The Exorcist.synopsis: A mother turns to two priests when her young daughter seems to be possessed by an ancient evil.

The Fall of the House of Usher.author: Edgar Allan Poe
The Fall of the House of Usher.synopsis: A narrator visits an old friend in a decaying mansion and watches doom close in on the family.

The Fault in Our Stars.author: John Green
The Fault in Our Stars.synopsis: Hazel, a teenager living with cancer, meets Augustus Waters at a support group and her world changes.

The Ghost Pirates.author: William Hope Hodgson
The Ghost Pirates.synopsis: Aboard a haunted sailing ship, the crew is menaced by eerie figures that appear at night and make men vanish.

The Girl on the Train.author: Paula Hawkins
The Girl on the Train.synopsis: A commuter fixates on a couple she watches from the train window, then gets tangled in a disappearance.

The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo.author: Stieg Larsson
The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo.synopsis: A disgraced journalist and a brilliant hacker investigate a wealthy family’s decades-old disappearance.

The Giver.author: Lois Lowry
The Giver.synopsis: Jonas lives in a seemingly perfect community until he is chosen to hold its forgotten memories.

The Golden Compass.author: Philip Pullman
The Golden Compass.synopsis: Lyra sets out to find kidnapped children, carrying a truth-telling device and guided by her animal companion.

The Graveyard Book.author: Neil Gaiman
The Graveyard Book.synopsis: After his family is murdered, a toddler is raised by ghosts in a graveyard, away from the killer who is still hunting him.

The Great Gatsby.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
The Great Gatsby.synopsis: In the Jazz Age, Nick watches his mysterious neighbor Jay Gatsby chase a lost love at lavish parties.

The Handmaid’s Tale.author: Margaret Atwood
The Handmaid’s Tale.synopsis: In the theocratic republic of Gilead, a handmaid tells of life under a regime that controls women’s bodies.

The Hating Game.author: Sally Thorne
The Hating Game.synopsis: Two rival coworkers fight for the same promotion while the tension between them keeps growing.

The Haunting of Hill House.author: Shirley Jackson
The Haunting of Hill House.synopsis: Four strangers spend a summer in a notorious haunted mansion that seems to have a will of its own.

The Historian.author: Elizabeth Kostova
The Historian.synopsis: A young woman follows her father’s trail across Europe to uncover the truth about Dracula.

The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy.author: Douglas Adams
The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy.synopsis: Arthur Dent is whisked off Earth moments before it is demolished and goes on a hilarious intergalactic trip.

The Hobbit.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
The Hobbit.synopsis: Comfort-loving Bilbo Baggins joins a band of dwarves and a wizard on a journey to reclaim treasure from a dragon.

The Host.author: Stephenie Meyer
The Host.synopsis: Earth is taken over by gentle aliens, but a human girl’s mind refuses to disappear.

The Hound of the Baskervilles.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
The Hound of the Baskervilles.synopsis: Holmes and Watson confront the legend of a spectral hound haunting a family on the foggy moors.

The Hunchback of Notre-Dame.author: Victor Hugo
The Hunchback of Notre-Dame.synopsis: In medieval Paris, the bell-ringer Quasimodo, a captivating dancer and a cruel archdeacon are bound together by obsession.

The Hunger Games.author: Suzanne Collins
The Hunger Games.synopsis: Katniss volunteers to take her sister’s place in a televised fight to the death between teenagers.

The Inheritance Games.author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
The Inheritance Games.synopsis: A teenager inherits a billionaire’s fortune from a stranger and moves into a mansion full of puzzles and secrets.

The Iron King.author: Julie Kagawa
The Iron King.synopsis: Meghan learns she is half faerie royalty and must cross into the Nevernever to rescue her little brother.

The Jungle Book.author: Rudyard Kipling
The Jungle Book.synopsis: Mowgli, a boy raised by wolves, learns the laws of the jungle and faces the tiger Shere Khan.

The Kissing Booth.author: Beth Reekles
The Kissing Booth.synopsis: Elle falls for her best friend’s older brother, breaking the one rule they were never supposed to break.

The Knife of Never Letting Go.author: Patrick Ness
The Knife of Never Letting Go.synopsis: On a planet where everyone hears each other’s thoughts, Todd discovers a patch of silence that puts him on the run.

The Little Prince.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
The Little Prince.synopsis: A pilot stranded in the desert meets a small prince from another planet who tells him about love and loss.

The Lord of the Rings.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
The Lord of the Rings.synopsis: A humble hobbit must carry a ring of terrible power across a war-torn land to the only place it can be destroyed.

The Love Hypothesis.author: Ali Hazelwood
The Love Hypothesis.synopsis: A PhD student fakes a relationship with a young professor to convince her best friend she is moving on.

The Lovely Bones.author: Alice Sebold
The Lovely Bones.synopsis: A murdered girl watches from heaven as her family struggles to move on and her killer remains free.

The Maid.author: Nita Prose
The Maid.synopsis: A hotel maid finds a guest dead in his room and becomes the main suspect.

The Martian.author: Andy Weir
The Martian.synopsis: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science, ingenuity and humor to survive until a rescue can reach him.

The Maze Runner.author: James Dashner
The Maze Runner.synopsis: Thomas wakes with no memory in a glade of boys surrounded by a deadly, ever-changing maze.

The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones.author: Cassandra Clare
The Mortal Instruments: City of Bones.synopsis: Clary witnesses a murder no one else can see and discovers she comes from a line of demon-hunting Shadowhunters.

The Murder of Roger Ackroyd.author: Agatha Christie
The Murder of Roger Ackroyd.synopsis: A retired Poirot investigates a murder in a quiet English village, in one of Christie’s most famous twists.

The Naturals.author: Jennifer Lynn Barnes
The Naturals.synopsis: Cassie, a gifted profiler, joins an FBI program for teens to help solve cold cases.

The Neverending Story.author: Michael Ende
The Neverending Story.synopsis: A shy boy reads a mysterious book and finds himself pulled into the magical world of Fantasia, which is in danger.

The Night Circus.author: Erin Morgenstern
The Night Circus.synopsis: Two young magicians are bound in a secret competition inside a mysterious circus that opens only at night.

The Notebook.author: Nicholas Sparks
The Notebook.synopsis: A summer romance between a poor Southern boy and a wealthy girl is tested by class, distance and the decades that follow.

The Odyssey.author: Homer
The Odyssey.synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus spends ten years facing monsters, gods and temptation on his way home.

The Passage.author: Justin Cronin
The Passage.synopsis: After a government experiment unleashes a vampire-like plague, a girl with a mysterious link to the infected becomes humanity’s hope over a century.

The Perks of Being a Wallflower.author: Stephen Chbosky
The Perks of Being a Wallflower.synopsis: Charlie writes letters about his first year of high school, friendships, love and painful memories.

The Phantom of the Opera.author: Gaston Leroux
The Phantom of the Opera.synopsis: A masked genius haunts the Paris Opera House and becomes obsessed with a young singer.

The Picture of Dorian Gray.author: Oscar Wilde
The Picture of Dorian Gray.synopsis: A beautiful young man stays forever young while his portrait ages with every one of his sins.

The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scient.author: Gideon Defoe
The Pirates! In an Adventure with Scient.synopsis: A comical pirate captain and his crew get tangled up with a young Charles Darwin.

The Princess Bride.author: William Goldman
The Princess Bride.synopsis: A farm boy turned pirate must rescue his beloved in a tale of sword fights, giants and miracles.

The Princess Diaries.author: Meg Cabot
The Princess Diaries.synopsis: An ordinary New York teen learns that she is the heir to the throne of a small European country.

The Priory of the Orange Tree.author: Samantha Shannon
The Priory of the Orange Tree.synopsis: A queen, a dragon rider, a mage and a hidden order of women find themselves on the same side as dragons return.

The Scorpio Races.author: Maggie Stiefvater
The Scorpio Races.synopsis: Puck and Sean race deadly water horses on an island beach in a contest that could change both of their lives.

The Sea Hawk.author: Rafael Sabatini
The Sea Hawk.synopsis: An English gentleman betrayed by his own family becomes a corsair on the Barbary Coast.

The Secret Garden.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
The Secret Garden.synopsis: A lonely orphan finds a hidden, locked garden on her uncle’s estate and brings it back to life.

The Selection.author: Kiera Cass
The Selection.synopsis: Thirty-five girls compete for a prince’s heart in a televised contest, and one of them never wanted to enter.

The Shining.author: Stephen King
The Shining.synopsis: A family becomes the winter caretaker of an isolated hotel whose dark presence slowly takes hold of the father.

The Silence of the Lambs.author: Thomas Harris
The Silence of the Lambs.synopsis: A young FBI trainee turns to imprisoned psychiatrist Hannibal Lecter for help to catch a serial killer.

The Silent Patient.author: Alex Michaelides
The Silent Patient.synopsis: After shooting her husband, a famous painter never speaks again, and a therapist becomes obsessed with finding out why.

The Spiderwick Chronicles.author: Tony DiTerlizzi and Holly Black
The Spiderwick Chronicles.synopsis: Three kids find a hidden field guide to faeries in their new home and enter a world they were never meant to see.

The Summer I Turned Pretty.author: Jenny Han
The Summer I Turned Pretty.synopsis: Belly spends one more summer at the beach house with two brothers who have shaped her whole childhood.

The Testing.author: Joelle Charbonneau
The Testing.synopsis: Cia competes in a series of deadly tests for a place at the only university left in her ruined world.

The Three Musketeers.author: Alexandre Dumas
The Three Musketeers.synopsis: Young d’Artagnan arrives in Paris to join the King’s Musketeers and is swept into court intrigue.

The Three-Body Problem.author: Liu Cixin
The Three-Body Problem.synopsis: A secret military project in China makes contact with an alien civilization that has its own plans for Earth.

The Thursday Murder Club.author: Richard Osman
The Thursday Murder Club.synopsis: Four retirees who meet weekly to study cold cases suddenly find themselves with a real murder.

The Time Machine.author: H. G. Wells
The Time Machine.synopsis: A Victorian inventor travels to the distant future and finds humanity split into two strange species.

The Turn of the Screw.author: Henry James
The Turn of the Screw.synopsis: A governess becomes convinced that ghosts are haunting the two children in her care.

The Vampire Diaries.author: L. J. Smith
The Vampire Diaries.synopsis: Elena is torn between two vampire brothers in a small town where something sinister lurks.

The War of the Worlds.author: H. G. Wells
The War of the Worlds.synopsis: Martians land in Victorian England and humanity is almost helpless against their machines.

The Westing Game.author: Ellen Raskin
The Westing Game.synopsis: Sixteen heirs of a dead millionaire must work in pairs to solve the puzzle of his death and win the fortune.

The Wicked King.author: Holly Black
The Wicked King.synopsis: Jude holds power over the faerie throne, but she must keep it while betrayal and secrets close in.

The Wind in the Willows.author: Kenneth Grahame
The Wind in the Willows.synopsis: Mole, Rat, Badger and the reckless Mr. Toad share riverside adventures in the English countryside.

The Witches.author: Roald Dahl
The Witches.synopsis: A boy learns that real witches exist and that they hate children, then must find a way to stop them.

The Woman in Black.author: Susan Hill
The Woman in Black.synopsis: A young lawyer sent to settle a dead woman’s affairs at a remote house is haunted by a terrifying ghost.

The Woman in the Window.author: A. J. Finn
The Woman in the Window.synopsis: An agoraphobic woman who spies on her neighbors believes she has seen a crime, and no one believes her.

The Woman in White.author: Wilkie Collins
The Woman in White.synopsis: A drawing teacher meets a mysterious woman in white on a lonely road and is drawn into a sinister plot.

The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.author: L. Frank Baum
The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.synopsis: A tornado carries Dorothy to the land of Oz, where she must follow the yellow brick road to find the Wizard.

The Wrath and the Dawn.author: Renée Ahdieh
The Wrath and the Dawn.synopsis: Shahrzad volunteers to marry a caliph who kills his brides each dawn and means to survive and end the cycle.

These Broken Stars.author: Amie Kaufman and Meagan Spooner
These Broken Stars.synopsis: Two survivors from different worlds crash-land on a mysterious planet and have to learn to trust each other.

Thirteen Reasons Why.author: Jay Asher
Thirteen Reasons Why.synopsis: Clay receives a box of recordings from a classmate who died, explaining the reasons behind her choice.

Throne of Glass.author: Sarah J. Maas
Throne of Glass.synopsis: A teenage assassin is pulled from a prison camp to compete as the king’s champion in a deadly tournament.

Through the Looking-Glass.author: Lewis Carroll
Through the Looking-Glass.synopsis: Alice steps through a mirror into a strange land where everything is a giant game of chess.

Tithe.author: Holly Black
Tithe.synopsis: Kaye finds out she is a faerie and is drawn into the dangerous conflict between rival courts.

To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before.author: Jenny Han
To All the Boys I’ve Loved Before.synopsis: Lara Jean’s secret love letters get mailed out, forcing her to face every boy she ever had a crush on.

Treasure Island.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
Treasure Island.synopsis: A boy finds a pirate’s treasure map and sails with a crew that includes the cunning Long John Silver.

Truly Devious.author: Maureen Johnson
Truly Devious.synopsis: At a school for geniuses in Vermont, Stevie investigates a decades-old kidnapping while new mysteries unfold.

Tuck Everlasting.author: Natalie Babbitt
Tuck Everlasting.synopsis: Winnie meets a family who drank from a spring of eternal life and must decide what such a gift means.

Twilight.author: Stephenie Meyer
Twilight.synopsis: Bella moves to a rainy town and falls for Edward, a mysterious classmate who hides a very dangerous secret.

Two Can Keep a Secret.author: Karen M. McManus
Two Can Keep a Secret.synopsis: Ellery moves to the town where her aunt vanished years ago and finds that a new killer may be at work.

Uglies.author: Scott Westerfeld
Uglies.synopsis: Tally cannot wait to turn pretty with an operation, until she learns the truth about her society.

Unwind.author: Neal Shusterman
Unwind.synopsis: Three teens marked to be “unwound,” their bodies harvested under a strange law, run to stay alive.

Uprooted.author: Naomi Novik
Uprooted.synopsis: Agnieszka is taken to the tower of a mysterious wizard to help defend her valley from the dangerous Wood.

Vampire Academy.author: Richelle Mead
Vampire Academy.synopsis: Rose, a half-vampire guardian in training, protects her best friend, a Moroi princess, from dangerous enemies.

Vampire Hunter D.author: Hideyuki Kikuchi
Vampire Hunter D.synopsis: In a far-future wasteland ruled by monsters, a half-vampire hunter is hired to rescue a girl from a vampire lord.

Vampire Kisses.author: Ellen Schreiber
Vampire Kisses.synopsis: Raven, a goth girl, is fascinated by the mysterious boy who moves into the old mansion in her town.

Verity.author: Colleen Hoover
Verity.synopsis: A struggling writer hired to finish a bestselling author’s series finds a disturbing manuscript hidden in her house.

Warcross.author: Marie Lu
Warcross.synopsis: Emika, a teenage hacker and bounty hunter, is recruited to find a threat inside the world’s most popular virtual game.

We Have Always Lived in the Castle.author: Shirley Jackson
We Have Always Lived in the Castle.synopsis: Merricat lives in isolation with her sister, until a visiting cousin threatens their strange, closed world.

We Were Liars.author: E. Lockhart
We Were Liars.synopsis: Cadence returns to her wealthy family’s private island and tries to piece together what happened two summers ago.

Wicked Lovely.author: Melissa Marr
Wicked Lovely.synopsis: Aislinn can see faeries, and the powerful Summer King has chosen her as his queen.

Wings.author: Aprilynne Pike
Wings.synopsis: Laurel discovers that she is not human when a flower unfolds from her back and reveals a faerie heritage.

Wings of Fire.author: Tui T. Sutherland
Wings of Fire.synopsis: Five young dragons are destined by a prophecy to end a brutal war between dragon tribes.

Wool.author: Hugh Howey
Wool.synopsis: Inside a giant underground silo, a sheriff begins to question the rules that keep everyone alive.

Wuthering Heights.author: Emily Brontë
Wuthering Heights.synopsis: Heathcliff and Catherine’s stormy, destructive love unfolds on the wild Yorkshire moors.

You.author: Caroline Kepnes
You.synopsis: A charming bookstore manager becomes dangerously obsessed with a customer and will do anything to be in her life.

’Salem’s Lot.author: Stephen King
’Salem’s Lot.synopsis: A writer returns to his Maine hometown and discovers it is slowly being overtaken by vampires.
